description: Evaluate job opportunities and draft truth-safe recruiter outreach, replies, referrals, and follow-ups.

capabilities: Evaluate job fit against your actual experience and constraints
Identify important gaps, blockers, and questions to clarify
Recommend whether to proceed, qualify first, or skip
Draft LinkedIn messages, recruiter replies, emails, and referral requests
Create concise application, scheduling, thank-you, and follow-up messages
Keep recruiter conversations consistent without repeating settled details
Handle compensation, location, availability, and work-authorization wording carefully
Avoid inventing experience, application status, contact details, or hiring-process facts
defaultPrompt: Check this job against my profile and tell me the best next outreach action.
What should I reply to this recruiter message?
Draft the best LinkedIn or email outreach for this role using my actual profile.
interface.longDescription: Job Outreach Copilot helps you evaluate job opportunities and turn them into clear, effective outreach. It compares a role with your actual experience, identifies important fit gaps or blockers, recommends the best next step, and drafts concise LinkedIn messages, recruiter replies, emails, referral requests, application follow-ups, and interview-stage communication. It keeps ongoing recruiter conversations consistent and avoids inventing experience, compensation, work authorization, application status, or other details you haven’t provided.

name: job-outreach-copilot
